verdict.rationale: Kushki publishes step-by-step integration guides for accepting card payments, authorization/capture and refunds, plus a kushki.js library and test-data/moving-to-production docs. That points to a documented path for building a payment flow from the docs. However, the evidence is only page titles: nothing shows the content contains copy-paste code samples, which languages are covered, or that integration fits within a day. Missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste code examples in multiple server languages or SDKs, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-payment.
